title: Yaaru nee? | Tamil Metro Love Song (Full Song) | ÆTHER
description:
A late girl, a metro door, one coffee spill, and the question that started it all: Yaaru nee? (Who are you?)
An original fun Tamil pop love song with a rap verse, told in 14 pictures on the Chennai metro.

Music, lyrics and characters are original; the voices and pictures are made with AI.
